description: This file contains unit tests for the MongoPersistenceOperationsSelectionProvider class, verifying its behavior under different configuration settings and its handling of entity selection, namespace selection, and immutability.

classes.name: MongoPersistenceOperationsSelectionProviderTest
classes.description: Unit test class for MongoPersistenceOperationsSelectionProvider, testing namespace and entity selection behavior.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that MongoPersistenceOperationsSelectionProvider class instances are immutable.

methods.name: selectNamespaceWhenNamespacesDisabledFails
methods.description: Verifies that selecting a namespace when namespaces are disabled throws UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: selectEntityWithoutNamespaceWhenNamespacesEnabledFails
methods.description: Verifies that selecting an entity without namespace when namespaces are enabled throws NamespacedEntityIdInvalidException.

methods.name: selectEntityWhenNamespacesDisabled
methods.description: Tests the entity selection behavior when namespaces are disabled, ensuring correct collection and filter generation.
